title: Apply for a State Library card
summary: Learn how to apply for a free State Library card to access services and collections.
intro:
All visitors to the State Library of NSW can use the computers, read the newspapers and magazines, and get general help from staff.

You'll need to apply for a State Library card to:
what_you_need: A valid NSW residential address (for NSW residents to access the full range of services)

how_to_steps.text: Go to Join the State Library of NSW.
On the page, select the option 'Become a Library Member'.
Follow the instructions to set up an account.
You'll receive your library card number via email (next business day).
You can choose to have your card sent by post or you can collect it at the State Library.
you'll need to pick up your card from the State Library
you can only access online resources and collection items from within the State Library.

faqs.q: Who can apply for a State Library card?
faqs.a: Anyone can apply for a library card.

faqs.q: What do I need to do to get a library card?
faqs.a: You must sign up for an account and provide an email address. NSW residents may also need to provide a valid NSW residential address to access the full range of services.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a State Library card?
faqs.a: Go to Join the State Library of NSW, select 'Become a Library Member', enter your personal details, and follow the instructions to set up an account. You will receive your card number via email the next business day.
